verdict.rationale: Docs confirm server-side session creation, Link-based hosted/drop-in flow with client-side callbacks (onEvent), document authentication, selfie/liveness checks, and webhooks for status updates plus a retry endpoint — covering the full create/redirect/read-result lifecycle without building capture UI. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of the integration experience, and no explicit code sample showing the server-side create-session call in this evidence pack.
